descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S28 Nursing Home Save & Extract and Generate: time, model, and the 'generating' state while the physician moves on

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6) (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Two NH residents, the first with a typed synthetic encounter; 10 cycles, NH only (the feature is mode-specific)

When Tap Save & Extract; tap Generate Note & Finish and immediately open the second resident; come back to the first

Then While away, the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and the note is there on return, or an explicit failure shows. Each step logs durationMs and providerMs and the model/provider (aiCallLog).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Pass/Fail: the 'generating' state is shown and the note (or an explicit failure) is there on return (3.5). Timings are targets, not pass/fail (3.5): record total vs providerMs per step, and flag any run over 30 s where the non-AI share (total − providerMs) is the larger part, for review with Vikram. Model per step (3.9). NH Save Note timing is TC-10 S19. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
